description: Land Title Settlement Department - Samanpura, Lunugamwehera D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830049
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (Nos. 59 and 60) in Hambantota District, including details about the land extent, ownership status (The State), and title classification. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters.
